name: Random Acts of Violence
body:
The commission of random acts of violence has brought you The Doomsbringer’s favor.

Prerequisite: Patron deity is a chaotic god of destruction

Benefit: You receive a +2 divine bonus to Bluff, Diplomacy, Disable Device or Stealth while you are committing or fleeing from a violent crime.
